title: Customer Loyalty Points Ledger & Audited Manual Adjustments

intro.title: Loyalty Points Ledger & Adjustments
intro.subtitle: Track point history, bill accruals, cash redemption values, and audited manual adjustments

narration.text: Welcome to Phase 6, Part 4: Customer Loyalty Points Ledger and Audited Manual Adjustments. Maintaining transparent point histories ensures customer trust and allows goodwill credits when resolving service concerns.
Open a customer profile and click Loyalty Ledger. The summary cards display their active reward balance, rupee purchasing value, and lifetime points earned.
The transaction history lists every point accrual from counter invoices and point redemptions, complete with timestamps and linked bill numbers.
To grant promotional goodwill points or resolve a discrepancy, click Adjust Points. Specify the points, and enter an audit reason such as Customer Delight.
Save the adjustment. The customer's balance updates immediately, with the audit reason permanently logged. In Part 5, we cover Medical Representatives and Commission Tracking!

outro.takeaway: Customer Loyalty Ledger: Review lifetime point histories, verify bill-linked redemptions, and issue audited goodwill point adjustments securely.
